description: Create house.room, the places furniture and electronics live in.
rationale: Rooms are the only spatial dimension this inventory has. Everything else is located by naming one.

intents.comment: A room in the house. Items are located by naming one of these.

columns.name: room_id
columns.comment: Surrogate key. Identity is added by the next intent, which is the only order PostgreSQL accepts.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: What the household calls this room. Unique: two rooms with one name is an inventory nobody can use.

columns.name: floor
columns.comment: Storey the room is on. 0 is ground, negative is below ground.

columns.name: area_m2
columns.comment: Floor area in square metres. Null where nobody has measured it, which is the honest state for most rooms.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: When this row was last changed. Maintained by the house.touch_updated_at trigger.

intents.name: room_kind_idx
intents.comment: Rooms of one kind, for the per-kind rollups on the inventory screen.
